sources.title: PDF NVIDIA V100S Datasheet
sources.snippet: HBM2 With a combination of improved raw bandwidth of 900GB/s and higher DRAM utilization efficiency at 95%, V100 delivers 1.5X higher memory bandwidth over Pascal GPUs as measured on STREAM. V100 is now available in a 32GB configuration that doubles the memory of the standard 16GB offering.
